var SW=[['#e21c24','ఎరుపు'],['#ff8a00','కాషాయం'],['#713912','గోధుమ'],['#ffffff','తెలుపు'],['#000000','నలుపు']],tcol='#ff8a00',custom=null;
function customCfg(){var W=custom?custom.width:1080,H=custom?custom.height:1350,m=Math.min(W,H);
 return {W:W,H:H,free:true,

var cur='shastri',bg={},photo=null,isCut=false,cutBox=null,fontsOK=false;
var cv=document.getElementById('cv'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');
function $(i){return document.getElementById(i)}
function b64(s){return s}
Promise.all([
 new FontFace('TeluguF','url(data:font/woff2;base64,)',{weight:'700'}).load(),
 new FontFace('DejaVuF','url(data:font/woff2;base64,)',{weight:'700'}).load()
]).then(function(f){f.forEach(function(x){document.fonts.add(x)});fontsOK=true;draw()}).catch(function(){fontsOK=true;draw()});

function runs(t){var out=[],c='',tel=null;
 for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){var ch=t[i],code=ch.charCodeAt(0);
  var isT=(code>=0x0c00&&code<=0x0c7f)||code==0x200c||code==0x200d;
  var tt=(ch==' '&&tel!==null)?tel:isT;
  if(tel===null||tt===tel){c+=ch;tel=tt}else{out.push([c,tel]);c=ch;tel=tt}}
 if(c)out.push([c,tel]);return out}
function fnt(sz,tel){return tel?('700 '+sz+'px TeluguF, sans-serif'):('700 '+(sz*0.85)+'px DejaVuF, sans-serif')}
function tw(t,sz){var w=0;runs(t).forEach(function(r){cx.font=fnt(sz,r[1]);w+=cx.measureText(r[0]).width});return w}
function drawLine(t,o,alpha){
 t=t.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(!t)return;
 var sz=o.size;while(sz>8&&tw(t,sz)>o.maxW)sz--;
 var x=o.cx-tw(t,sz)/2;
 cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=alpha;cx.fillStyle=o.color;cx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
 runs(t).forEach(function(r){cx.font=fnt(sz,r[1]);
  var base=r[1]?(o.y+0.87*sz):(o.y+0.08*sz+0.93*0.85*sz);
  if(o.stroke){cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=alpha;cx.lineJoin='round';cx.lineWidth=Math.max(2,sz*0.14);
   cx.strokeStyle=(o.color=='#000000')?'#ffffff':'rgba(0,0,0,.85)';cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';cx.shadowBlur=sz*0.15;cx.shadowOffsetY=sz*0.04;cx.strokeText(r[0],x,base);cx.restore()}
  cx.fillText(r[0],x,base);x+=cx.measureText(r[0]).width});
 cx.restore()}

function draw(preview){
 if(preview===undefined)preview=true;
 var c=cur=='custom'?customCfg():CFG[cur];cv.width=c.W;cv.height=c.H;
 if(cur=='custom'){if(custom)cx.drawImage(custom,0,0,c.W,c.H);else{cx.fillStyle='#dfe6ef';cx.fillRect(0,0,c.W,c.H);cx.fillStyle='#456';cx.textAlign='center';cx.font=fnt(c.W/16,true);cx.fillText('మీ పోస్టర్ ఇక్కడ వస్తుంది',c.W/2,c.H/2);cx.textAlign='left'}}
 else if(bg[cur])cx.drawImage(bg[cur],0,0,c.W,c.H);
 if(photo){
  var z=$('zoom').value/100,ox=$('ox').value/100,oy=$('oy').value/100;
  if(isCut){
   var b=cutBox,bw=b.w,bh=b.h,k=Math.min(c.cut.w/bw,c.cut.h/bh)*z;
   var dw=bw*k,dh=bh*k;
   var dx=c.cut.x+c.cut.w/2-dw/2+ox*(c.free?c.W*0.5:c.cut.w*0.5),dy=c.cut.bottom-dh+(c.free?oy*c.H*0.5:0);
   cx.drawImage(photo,b.x,b.y,bw,bh,dx,dy,dw,dh);
  }else{
   var iw=photo.width,ih=photo.height,side=Math.min(iw,ih)/z;
   if(c.free){z=1;side=Math.min(iw,ih);ox=0;oy=0}
   var scx=iw/2+ox*(iw-side)/2,scy=Math.min(ih*0.42,ih/2)+oy*(ih-side)/2;
   if(ih<=iw)scy=ih/2+oy*(ih-side)/2;
   var sx=Math.max(0,Math.min(iw-side,scx-side/2)),sy=Math.max(0,Math.min(ih-side,scy-side/2));
   var ci=c.circ;if(c.free){ci={cx:ci.cx+$('ox').value/100*c.W*0.5,cy:ci.cy+$('oy').value/100*c.H*0.5,D:ci.D,rings:ci.rings}}var R=ci.D/2,tot=0;
   ci.rings.forEach(function(r){tot+=r[0]});
   var rr=R;
   var rs=ci.rings.slice().reverse();
   var acc=0;ci.rings.forEach(function(r){acc+=r[0]});
   // draw rings from outermost
   var sorted=ci.rings.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b[0]-a[0]});
   sorted.forEach(function(r){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,R+r[0],0,6.2832);cx.fillStyle=r[1];cx.fill()});
   cx.save();cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,R,0,6.2832);cx.clip();
   cx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
   cx.drawImage(photo,sx,sy,side,side,ci.cx-R,ci.cy-R,ci.D,ci.D);cx.restore();
  }
 }else if(preview){
  var ci=c.circ;if(c.free){ci={cx:ci.cx+$('ox').value/100*c.W*0.5,cy:ci.cy+$('oy').value/100*c.H*0.5,D:ci.D}}cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=.5;cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,ci.D/2,0,6.2832);cx.fill();
  cx.globalAlpha=1;cx.fillStyle='#456';cx.font=fnt(ci.D/9,true);cx.textAlign='center';cx.fillText('మీ ఫోటో',ci.cx,ci.cy);cx.restore()}
 var n=$('nm').value.trim(),t=$('tt').value.trim();
 drawLine(n||(preview?'మీ పేరు':''),c.name,n?1:.45);
 drawLine(t||(preview?'మీ పదవి':''),c.title,t?1:.45);
}

function setMode(k){cur=k;var cu=k=='custom';
 document.querySelectorAll('.tpl').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x.dataset.k==k)});
 $('tx').style.display=cu?'block':'none';$('bgw').style.display=cu&&custom?'block':'none';
 $('oyw').style.display=(cu||!isCut)&&photo?'block':'none';
 if(cu){$('oyw').querySelector('b').textContent='పైన - కింద';$('lz').textContent='పెద్దది - చిన్నది'}else{$('oyw').querySelector('b').textContent='పైకి - కిందకు';$('lz').textContent='ఫోటో సైజు'}
 draw()}
document.querySelectorAll('.tpl').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){
 if(b.dataset.k=='custom'&&!custom){$('bgfile').click();return}
 setMode(b.dataset.k)}});
$('bgpick').onclick=function(){$('bgfile').click()};
$('bgfile').onchange=function(e){var f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;var u=URL.createObjectURL(f),im=new Image();
 im.onload=function(){var MAX=2400,k=Math.min(1,MAX/Math.max(im.width,im.height));
  var w=Math.round(im.width*k),h=Math.round(im.height*k),cc=document.createElement('canvas');cc.width=w;cc.height=h;
  var g=cc.getContext('2d');g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(im,0,0,w,h);custom=cc;URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  $('ty').value=86;$('tx1').value=0;setMode('custom')};
 im.onerror=function(){alert('ఈ ఫైల్ తెరవలేకపోయాను. వేరే ఫోటో ఎంచుకోండి.')};im.src=u;e.target.value=''};
SW.forEach(function(c){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.style.background=c[0];b.title=c[1];b.setAttribute('aria-label',c[1]);
 if(c[0]==tcol)b.className='on';b.onclick=function(){tcol=c[0];document.querySelectorAll('#sw button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});b.className='on';draw()};$('sw').appendChild(b)});
$('pick').onclick=function(){$('file').click()};
['zoom','ox','oy','nm','tt','ts','tx1','ty'].forEach(function(i){$(i).addEventListener('input',function(){draw()})});
function prep(im,MAX){
 var sc=Math.min(1,MAX/Math.max(im.width,im.height));
 var w=Math.round(im.width*sc),h=Math.round(im.height*sc);
 var cc=document.createElement('canvas');cc.width=w;cc.height=h;var g=cc.getContext('2d');g.drawImage(im,0,0,w,h);
 var d=g.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data,tr=0,minx=w,miny=h,maxx=0,maxy=0;
 for(var y=0;y<h;y++)for(var x=0;x<w;x++){var a=d[(y*w+x)*4+3];if(a<200)tr++;if(a>20){if(x<minx)minx=x;if(x>maxx)maxx=x;if(y<miny)miny=y;if(y>maxy)maxy=y}}
 var cut=(tr/(w*h)>0.02)&&maxx>minx&&maxy>miny;
 return {cc:cc,cut:cut,box:cut?{x:minx,y:miny,w:maxx-minx+1,h:maxy-miny+1}:null}}
function usePhoto(im){
 var r=prep(im,2400);isCut=r.cut;photo=r.cc;cutBox=r.box;
 $('zoom').value=100;$('ox').value=0;$('oy').value=0;
 $('ctl').style.display='block';$('oyw').style.display=(isCut&&cur!='custom')?'none':'block';
 $('mode').textContent=isCut?'బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్ లేని ఫోటో - పోస్టర్ లో నిలబడినట్లు పెట్టాను.':'మామూలు ఫోటో - గుండ్రంగా పెట్టాను. ముఖం మధ్యలో వచ్చేలా కింద స్లైడర్లు కదపండి.';
 draw()}
$('file').onchange=function(e){
 var f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;
 var u=URL.createObjectURL(f),im=new Image();
 im.onload=function(){usePhoto(im);URL.revokeObjectURL(u)};
 im.src=u};
$('dl').onclick=function(){
 if(!$('nm').value.trim()){alert('ముందు మీ పేరు రాయండి');$('nm').focus();return}
 draw(false);
 cv.toBlob(function(bl){
  var url=URL.createObjectURL(bl);
  var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='poster.png';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
  $('resimg').src=url;$('result').style.display='block';
  draw(true);
 },'image/png')};

/* ---- profile + occasions ---- */
var OCC={shastri:[10,2],gandhi:[10,2],frame:[10,2],flexiA:[10,2],flexiB:[10,2]};
var PROF=null,PPH=null,PPCUT=false;
try{PROF=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pm_profile')||'null')}catch(e){PROF=null}
function daysTo(m,d){var n=new Date(),t=new Date(n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n.getDate()),x=new Date(n.getFullYear(),m-1,d);if(x<t)x=new Date(n.getFullYear()+1,m-1,d);return Math.round((x-t)/86400000)}
function orderTpls(){
 var box=document.querySelector('.tpls'),cards=[].slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('.tpl')),lead=PROF&&PROF.party=='BJP'||!PROF;
 cards.forEach(function(b){var k=b.dataset.k;if(k=='custom')return;
  b.style.display=(k=='flexiA'&&PROF&&PROF.party!='BJP')?'none':'';
  var old=b.querySelector('.bd');if(old)old.remove();
  var n=daysTo(OCC[k][0],OCC[k][1]),sp=document.createElement('span');sp.className='bd'+(n==0?'':' t');
  sp.textContent=n==0?'ఈరోజు':(n+' రోజుల్లో');b.appendChild(sp);b._n=n;b._o=['flexiA','flexiB','frame','gandhi','shastri'].indexOf(k)});
 cards.sort(function(a,b){if(a.dataset.k=='custom')return 1;if(b.dataset.k=='custom')return -1;return (a._n-b._n)||(a._o-b._o)});
 cards.forEach(function(b){box.appendChild(b)})}
function showProfForm(editing){
 $('prof').style.display='block';$('chip').style.display='none';
 $('pf_nm').value=PROF?PROF.name:'';$('pf_tt').value=PROF?PROF.title:'';$('pf_pt').value=PROF?PROF.party:'BJP';
 PPH=PROF?PROF.photo:null;PPCUT=PROF?!!PROF.cut:false;
 $('pimg').style.display=PPH?'block':'none';$('pnone').style.display=PPH?'none':'block';if(PPH)$('pimg').src=PPH;
 $('pcancel').style.display=editing?'block':'none'}
function applyProf(){
 $('prof').style.display='none';$('chip').style.display='flex';
 $('chipnm').textContent=PROF.name;$('chiptt').textContent=PROF.title;if(PROF.photo)$('chipimg').src=PROF.photo;
 $('nm').value=PROF.name;$('tt').value=PROF.title;
 $('adv').open=false;orderTpls();
 if(PROF.photo){var im=new Image();im.onload=function(){usePhoto(im)};im.src=PROF.photo}
 var first=document.querySelector('.tpls .tpl:not(.up):not([style*="none"])');if(first)setMode(first.dataset.k)}
$('ppick').onclick=function(){$('pfile').click()};
$('pfile').onchange=function(e){var f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;var u=URL.createObjectURL(f),im=new Image();
 im.onload=function(){var r=prep(im,1400);PPCUT=r.cut;
  var cc=r.cc;if(r.cut){var bx=r.box,c2=document.createElement('canvas');c2.width=bx.w;c2.height=bx.h;c2.getContext('2d').drawImage(cc,bx.x,bx.y,bx.w,bx.h,0,0,bx.w,bx.h);cc=c2}
  PPH=r.cut?cc.toDataURL('image/png'):cc.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.9);
  $('pimg').src=PPH;$('pimg').style.display='block';$('pnone').style.display='none';URL.revokeObjectURL(u)};
 im.onerror=function(){alert('ఈ ఫైల్ తెరవలేకపోయాను. వేరే ఫోటో ఎంచుకోండి.')};im.src=u;e.target.value=''};
$('psave').onclick=function(){
 var n=$('pf_nm').value.trim();if(!n){alert('ముందు మీ పేరు రాయండి');$('pf_nm').focus();return}
 if(!PPH){alert('మీ ఫోటో ఎంచుకోండి');return}
 var p={name:n,title:$('pf_tt').value.trim(),party:$('pf_pt').value,photo:PPH,cut:PPCUT};
 try{localStorage.setItem('pm_profile',JSON.stringify(p))}catch(e){alert('ఫోటో పెద్దగా ఉంది, ఈ ఫోన్ లో సేవ్ కాలేదు. ఈసారి మాత్రమే వాడుతున్నాను.')}
 PROF=p;applyProf()};
$('pedit').onclick=function(){showProfForm(true)};
$('pcancel').onclick=function(){applyProf()};
if(PROF)applyProf();else{showProfForm(false);orderTpls()}
